results.title: Alphabet hits $4 trillion market capitalization
results.content:
Google parent company Alphabet has become the fourth member of the $4 trillion club
The stock closed at $331.86, putting Alphabet's market cap just over $4 trillion.
The search company joins Nvidia, Microsoft and Apple as the few companies that have crossed the $4 trillion mark.

The only U.S. companies that have hit a $4 trillion market cap are Nvidia , Apple , and Microsoft .
